Symptoms: accept button disabled due to missing org-type field in accept modal. Customer tried browsers and cookie clear — same. They are on Coupa.
Repro notes from our logs: tenant accept page returns 200 but payload returns acceptForm: {fields: ["company_name", "email"]} — org_type missing. I suspect a locale / server-side rendering fallback stripping the optional field. Could be a UI feature flag or a server-side template missing when accept-locale header != en.

Immediate ask: can we either (A) manually mark tenant accepted for AuroraCorp to allow PO creation, or (B) patch the form to render org_type even if missing, and force a soft-accept?

Attached: support-dump-0624.log (sampling of request/response).

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachment: support-dump-0624.log (text/plain)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Jul 2026 11:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Portal invite failing — acceptance step hidden, blocking PO creation

I've reproduced the issue locally using the same request headers they sent. The org_type input is conditionally rendered and the condition is incorrectly tied to the Accept-Language header fallback path. When Accept-Language falls back to a secondary locale (we saw fr-FR in one test), the form template omits the org_type control.

Workaround I tested: call the tenant API endpoint /tenants/:id/acceptance with body {accepted: true} as an admin — flips acceptance and allows PO creation. I can run that for AuroraCorp if Rishi gets their go-ahead.

Marissa, this looks like a small template guard to remove. Can you take a look and roll a hotfix? ETA?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Support & Integrations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Thanks for the heads up. I pushed a hotfix to staging to remove the locale guard and force org_type to render when the form is served. Deployed to prod at 13:15 PT after smoke-tests.

I also ran the admin acceptance flip as Ben suggested for AuroraCorp tenant id AC-7732 so you should see the tenant status change.

I'll follow up after Lena confirms.
